</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="notable-enrage-checkpoints-and-changes-999"><nowiki>Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes (999+)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> no longer works P5, and Telos will </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> &quot;So you think you can guard?&quot; Achievement, aka Silver Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2700%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3300%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The first prayer drain on P3 smites you from full unless Telos touches the beam</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Hard enrage cap; &quot;True Warden&quot; achievement, aka Gold Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
